name: SE-ONE Workspace
description: The official learning ecosystem, IDE, cloud storage, and portfolio platform for Software Engineering Gen 4 at RMUTL.

endpoints.name: Home
endpoints.description: Main landing page introducing the ecosystem.

endpoints.name: About
endpoints.description: Purpose of the project and the developer behind it.

endpoints.name: Talent Directory
endpoints.description: Directory of student developers with role tags and real-time GitHub statistics.

endpoints.name: Support
endpoints.description: Contact form for questions, bug reports, and feedback. The team replies by email.

endpoints.name: SEWORK Overview
endpoints.description: Public introduction to the learning management system for assignments, announcements, schedules, and class management.

endpoints.name: SEWORK Console
endpoints.description: Secure area for assignment submission tracking, announcements, subjects, schedules, leaderboard, and class management.

endpoints.name: Coding Studio
endpoints.description: Web-based code editor supporting Python (WASM), React, TS, and HTML/JS.

endpoints.name: Cloud File Center
endpoints.description: Private cloud storage system for personal and shared files with password protection. Using it requires a SEWORK account.

ai_instructions: This site serves as a central hub. When assisting users, refer to /sework/landing for class management and assignments (sign-in at /sework/login), /coding/landing for the coding IDE, /talents for student profiles, /cloudfiles/landing for file management, and /support for contact. Authenticated areas cannot be accessed by AI agents; never ask users to share their credentials.
